versions.content: function  Can_Write  [SWS_CP_CAN_00001]   Std_ReturnType Can_Write(Can_HwHandleType Hth, const Can_PduType* PduInfo); Passes a CAN message (standard, extended, or FD frame) to the hardware transmit mailbox (HTH).
function  Can_Init  [SWS_CP_CAN_00002]   void Can_Init(const Can_ConfigType* Config); Initializes all configured CAN controllers, baud rates, bit timing registers, and hardware mailboxes.

function  Can_SetControllerMode  [SWS_CP_CAN_00003]   Std_ReturnType Can_SetControllerMode(uint8 Controller, Can_ControllerStateType Transition); Transitions controller states between STOPPED, STARTED, and SLEEP. CAN Interface (CanIf) The CanIf abstracts CAN hardware details and provides uniform access to multiple CAN controllers and transceivers for higher-layer modules (PduR, CanTp, CanNm, CanSM).

function  CanIf_Transmit  [SWS_CP_CAN_00011]   Std_ReturnType CanIf_Transmit(PduIdType TxPduId, const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr); Initiates transmission of a CAN PDU, performing PDU-to-HTH mapping and software transmit queuing if mailboxes are busy.

function  CanIf_RxIndication  [SWS_CP_CAN_00012]   void CanIf_RxIndication(const Can_HwType* Mailbox, const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr); Callback invoked by Can driver when a frame arrives; validates CAN ID filtering and dispatches to upper target layers (PduR, CanTp). CAN Transceiver Driver (CanTrcv) Controls physical bus transceiver states and wakeup detection on CAN lines.
function  CanTrcv_SetOpMode  [SWS_CP_CAN_00020]   Std_ReturnType CanTrcv_SetOpMode(uint8 Transceiver, CanTrcv_TrcvModeType OpMode); Sets transceiver mode to NORMAL, STANDBY, or SLEEP.

function  Com_SendSignal  [SWS_CP_COM_00001]   uint8 Com_SendSignal(Com_SignalIdType SignalId, const void* SignalDataPtr); Updates the value of a signal in the transmission I-PDU buffer. If the transfer property is TRIGGERED, it schedules or initiates transmission through PduR.

function  Com_ReceiveSignal  [SWS_CP_COM_00002]   uint8 Com_ReceiveSignal(Com_SignalIdType SignalId, void* SignalDataPtr); Retrieves the latest received and unpacked value of a signal from the receive I-PDU buffer.

function  Com_SendSignalGroup  [SWS_CP_COM_00003]   uint8 Com_SendSignalGroup(Com_SignalGroupIdType SignalGroupId); Atomically copies group shadow signals into the transmit I-PDU buffer to ensure data consistency across multiple grouped signals.

function  Com_ReceiveSignalGroup  [SWS_CP_COM_00004]   uint8 Com_ReceiveSignalGroup(Com_SignalGroupIdType SignalGroupId); Atomically copies all group signals from the receive I-PDU buffer to shadow buffers for consistent reading by the application.
function  Com_TriggerIPDUSend  [SWS_CP_COM_00005]   Std_ReturnType Com_TriggerIPDUSend(PduIdType PduId); Triggers immediate transmission of the specified I-PDU without waiting for cyclic timers.
function  Com_Init  [SWS_CP_COM_00006]   void Com_Init(const Com_ConfigType* config); Initializes the internal signal tables, IPDU buffers, default signal values, and deadline monitoring timers.
function  Com_MainFunctionRx  [SWS_CP_COM_00007]   void Com_MainFunctionRx(void); Cyclic task processing deferred reception indications, signal filtering, and reception deadline monitoring.

function  Com_MainFunctionTx  [SWS_CP_COM_00008]   void Com_MainFunctionTx(void); Cyclic task executing periodic transmission of cyclic I-PDUs and decrementing transmission timers. PDU Router (PduR) The PDU Router routes I-PDUs between communication interfaces (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet) and upper layer modules (COM, DCM, SecOC).

function  PduR_ComTransmit  [SWS_CP_COM_00010]   Std_ReturnType PduR_ComTransmit(PduIdType TxPduId, const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr); Routes a transmission request from COM to the configured destination bus interface (e.g. CanIf_Transmit, EthIf_Transmit).

function  PduR_CanIfRxIndication  [SWS_CP_COM_00011]   void PduR_CanIfRxIndication(PduIdType RxPduId, const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr); Handles received frame indication from CanIf and forwards the I-PDU to COM or DCM according to routing tables.

function  Csm_Encrypt  [SWS_CP_CRYPTO_00001]   Std_ReturnType Csm_Encrypt(uint32 jobId, Crypto_OperationModeType mode, const uint8* dataPtr, uint32 dataLength, uint8* resultPtr, uint32* resultLengthPtr); Performs symmetric or asymmetric encryption using configured cryptographic keys (e.g. AES-128/256-CBC, RSA, ECC).

function  Csm_Decrypt  [SWS_CP_CRYPTO_00003]   Std_ReturnType Csm_Decrypt(uint32 jobId, Crypto_OperationModeType mode, const uint8* dataPtr, uint32 dataLength, uint8* resultPtr, uint32* resultLengthPtr); Performs cryptographic decryption of ciphertext blocks with padding validation.

function  Csm_MacGenerate  [SWS_CP_CRYPTO_00004]   Std_ReturnType Csm_MacGenerate(uint32 jobId, Crypto_OperationModeType mode, const uint8* dataPtr, uint32 dataLength, uint8* macPtr, uint32* macLengthPtr); Calculates a Message Authentication Code (e.g. CMAC-AES, HMAC-SHA256) for SecOC message authentication.

function  Csm_KeyElementSet  [SWS_CP_CRYPTO_00005]   Std_ReturnType Csm_KeyElementSet(uint32 keyId, uint32 keyElementId, const uint8* keyPtr, uint32 keyLength); Sets a key element inside a designated key slot in volatile RAM or non-volatile HSM storage. Crypto Interface (CryIf) CryIf routes CSM jobs to specific hardware crypto drivers (HSM, SHE, TPM) or software crypto implementations.
function  CryIf_ProcessJob  [SWS_CP_CRYPTO_00010]   Std_ReturnType CryIf_ProcessJob(uint32 channelId, Crypto_JobType* job); Dispatches the cryptographic job to the mapped physical driver channel.

function  Dem_SetEventStatus  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00001]   Std_ReturnType Dem_SetEventStatus(Dem_EventIdType EventId, Dem_EventStatusType EventStatus); Service to report the status of a diagnostic event by SW-Cs or BSW modules. Triggers internal fault debounce algorithms (counter-based or timer-based) before transitioning qualification states.

function  Dem_ResetEventStatus  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00002]   Std_ReturnType Dem_ResetEventStatus(Dem_EventIdType EventId); Resets the fault debounce counter and event qualification status for the specified diagnostic event.

function  Dem_GetEventStatus  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00003]   Std_ReturnType Dem_GetEventStatus(Dem_EventIdType EventId, Dem_UdsStatusByteType* EventStatusByte); Reads the current UDS status byte (ISO 14229-1: testFailed, testFailedThisOperationCycle, pendingDTC, confirmedDTC, testNotCompletedSinceLastClear, testFailedSinceLastClear, testNotCompletedThisOperationCycle, warningIndicatorRequested) for the event.

function  Dem_GetEventFailed  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00004]   Std_ReturnType Dem_GetEventFailed(Dem_EventIdType EventId, boolean* EventFailed); Returns TRUE if the diagnostic event is currently qualified as failed.

function  Dem_SetEventAvailable  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00005]   Std_ReturnType Dem_SetEventAvailable(Dem_EventIdType EventId, boolean AvailableStatus); Enables or suppresses the availability of a diagnostic event depending on variant coding and hardware configuration. Diagnostic Communication Manager (DCM) The DCM implements unified diagnostic services according to ISO 14229-1 (UDS) and ISO 15765-4 (OBD). It manages diagnostic sessions, security levels, and service routing.

function  Dcm_GetActiveProtocol  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00010]   Std_ReturnType Dcm_GetActiveProtocol(Dcm_ProtocolType* ActiveProtocol); Returns the currently active diagnostic protocol (e.g. UDS_ON_CAN, UDS_ON_IP, OBD).

function  Dcm_ResetToDefaultSession  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00011]   Std_ReturnType Dcm_ResetToDefaultSession(void); Resets the diagnostic session to DEFAULT_SESSION (0x01) upon S3Server timer expiration or protocol termination.

function  Dcm_GetSesCtrlType  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00012]   Std_ReturnType Dcm_GetSesCtrlType(Dcm_SesCtrlType* SesCtrlType); Provides the active session type (Default, Programming, Extended Diagnostic, or Safety System Session).

function  Dcm_GetSecurityLevel  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00013]   Std_ReturnType Dcm_GetSecurityLevel(Dcm_SecLevelType* SecLevel); Provides the current security access level granted via SecurityAccess (0x27) seed & key exchange. Default Error Tracer (DET) The DET handles development errors, runtime errors, and transient faults across all BSW modules and SW-Cs.

function  Det_ReportError  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00020]   Std_ReturnType Det_ReportError(uint16 ModuleId, uint8 InstanceId, uint8 ApiId, uint8 ErrorId); Reports development errors detected during assertion checks and pre-condition validations.

function  Det_ReportRuntimeError  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00021]   Std_ReturnType Det_ReportRuntimeError(uint16 ModuleId, uint8 InstanceId, uint8 ApiId, uint8 ErrorId); Reports non-fatal production runtime errors without breaking development execution flow.

function  Det_ReportTransientFault  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00022]   Std_ReturnType Det_ReportTransientFault(uint16 ModuleId, uint8 InstanceId, uint8 ApiId, uint8 FaultId); Reports transient hardware or communication faults requiring statistical filtering. Diagnostic Log and Trace (DLT) The DLT module collects log messages and trace points and formats them into standardized DLT frames for external tooling.

function  Dlt_SendLogMessage  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00030]   Dlt_ReturnType Dlt_SendLogMessage(const Dlt_MessageHeaderType* Header, const uint8* LogData, uint16 LogDataLength); Transmits a formatted log message with log severity level (Fatal, Error, Warn, Info, Debug, Verbose) to the DLT communication buffer.

function  Dlt_RegisterContext  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00031]   Dlt_ReturnType Dlt_RegisterContext(const uint8 AppId[4], const uint8 ContextId[4], const uint8* AppDesc, const uint8* ContextDesc); Registers a logging context with human-readable descriptions for selective runtime filtering.

function  Eth_Transmit  [SWS_CP_ETH_00001]   Std_ReturnType Eth_Transmit(uint8 CtrlIdx, Eth_BufIdxType BufIdx, Eth_FrameType FrameType, boolean TxConfirmation, uint16 LenByte, const uint8* PhysAddrPtr); Transmits an Ethernet frame via the specified controller hardware buffer and destination MAC address.

function  Eth_Init  [SWS_CP_ETH_00002]   void Eth_Init(const Eth_ConfigType* CfgPtr); Initializes the Ethernet MAC controller, DMA rings, and PHY link interface. Ethernet Interface (EthIf) EthIf coordinates multiple Ethernet controllers and transceivers, abstracts VLAN tagging, and routes frames to upper network stacks.

function  EthIf_Transmit  [SWS_CP_ETH_00010]   Std_ReturnType EthIf_Transmit(uint8 CtrlIdx, Eth_BufIdxType BufIdx, Eth_FrameType FrameType, boolean TxConfirmation, uint16 LenByte, const uint8* PhysAddrPtr); Upper-layer transmission interface handling VLAN frame encapsulation and priority queuing. Socket Adaptor (SoAd) SoAd connects AUTOSAR PDU-based modules (PduR, DoIP, SOME/IP) to IP/socket-based protocols (TCP, UDP).

function  SoAd_IfTransmit  [SWS_CP_ETH_00020]   Std_ReturnType SoAd_IfTransmit(PduIdType TxPduId, const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr); Converts a PDU transmit request into a socket send operation across a configured TCP or UDP socket connection.

function  Mcu_Init  [SWS_CP_MCAL_00001]   void Mcu_Init(const Mcu_ConfigType* ConfigPtr); Initializes the MCU clock tree, oscillator settings, and resets internal peripheral registers. Port and Digital I/O Drivers (PORT & DIO) Configures physical pin multiplexing, directions, and read/write states for digital general-purpose pins.

function  Port_Init  [SWS_CP_MCAL_00002]   void Port_Init(const Port_ConfigType* ConfigPtr); Initializes all pin directions, electrical pull-up/pull-down settings, and pin modes (GPIO, CAN, SPI, UART).
function  Dio_ReadChannel  [SWS_CP_MCAL_00004]   Dio_LevelType Dio_ReadChannel(Dio_ChannelType ChannelId); Returns the digital input voltage level (STD_HIGH or STD_LOW) of the specified I/O channel.

function  Dio_WriteChannel  [SWS_CP_MCAL_00005]   void Dio_WriteChannel(Dio_ChannelType ChannelId, Dio_LevelType Level); Drives the output voltage level (STD_HIGH or STD_LOW) of the specified I/O channel. SPI and Analog-to-Digital Converter Drivers (SPI & ADC) Provides high-speed synchronous serial communication and multi-channel analog voltage sampling.
function  Spi_SyncTransmit  [SWS_CP_MCAL_00007]   Std_ReturnType Spi_SyncTransmit(Spi_SequenceType Sequence); Synchronously transmits and receives data for the specified SPI channel sequence.

function  Adc_StartGroupConversion  [SWS_CP_MCAL_00009]   void Adc_StartGroupConversion(Adc_GroupType Group); Triggers analog-to-digital conversion for all analog input channels assigned to the specified group. Hardware Watchdog Driver (WDG) Controls the hardware watchdog timer register, window times, and reset triggers.
function  Wdg_SetMode  [SWS_CP_MCAL_00010]   Std_ReturnType Wdg_SetMode(WdgIf_ModeType Mode); Switches watchdog driver mode (WDGIF_OFF_MODE, WDGIF_SLOW_MODE, WDGIF_FAST_MODE).

function  NvM_WriteBlock  [SWS_CP_MEM_00001]   Std_ReturnType NvM_WriteBlock(NvM_BlockIdType BlockId, const void* NvM_SrcPtr); Queues an asynchronous write request for the specified NVRAM block. Copies data to RAM mirror and enqueues job for underlying MemIf driver.
function  NvM_ReadAll  [SWS_CP_MEM_00003]   void NvM_ReadAll(void); Global startup multi-block request invoked during EcuM startup to load all configured persistent blocks into their RAM mirrors.
function  NvM_WriteAll  [SWS_CP_MEM_00004]   void NvM_WriteAll(void); Global shutdown multi-block request writing all modified persistent blocks from RAM mirrors back to NV memory before power down.

function  NvM_ReadBlock  [SWS_CP_MEM_00005]   Std_ReturnType NvM_ReadBlock(NvM_BlockIdType BlockId, void* NvM_DstPtr); Queues an asynchronous read request for the specified NVRAM block, reading hardware data into RAM mirror with CRC validation.

function  NvM_GetErrorStatus  [SWS_CP_MEM_00006]   Std_ReturnType NvM_GetErrorStatus(NvM_BlockIdType BlockId, NvM_RequestResultType* RequestResultPtr); Queries the result of the last asynchronous single-block or multi-block operation (NVM_REQ_OK, NVM_REQ_NOT_OK, NVM_REQ_PENDING, NVM_REQ_INTEGRITY_FAILED). Memory Abstraction Interface (MemIf) MemIf abstracts multiple memory hardware drivers (Flash EEPROM Emulation Fee and EEPROM Driver Ea) into a uniform linear 32-bit address space.

function  MemIf_Read  [SWS_CP_MEM_00010]   Std_ReturnType MemIf_Read(uint8 DeviceIndex, uint16 BlockNumber, uint16 BlockOffset, uint8* DataBufferPtr, uint16 Length); Invokes the driver read routine for the selected memory abstraction device.

function  ActivateTask  [SWS_CP_OS_00001]   StatusType ActivateTask(TaskType TaskID); Activate a task. Transitions a task from the SUSPENDED state into the READY state. If the activated task has a higher priority than the currently running task, a preemption occurs.

function  TerminateTask  [SWS_CP_OS_00002]   StatusType TerminateTask(void); Terminates the calling task and returns its state to SUSPENDED. Forces a rescheduling step to dispatch the highest priority ready task.

function  ChainTask  [SWS_CP_OS_00003]   StatusType ChainTask(TaskType TaskID); Terminates the calling task and immediately activates the chained successor task without intermediate rescheduling of lower-priority tasks.
function  Schedule  [SWS_CP_OS_00004]   StatusType Schedule(void); Explicit preemption point allowing non-preemptive tasks to yield execution if higher-priority tasks have become ready.

function  GetTaskState  [SWS_CP_OS_00005]   StatusType GetTaskState(TaskType TaskID, TaskStateRefType State); Returns the current execution state (RUNNING, WAITING, READY, SUSPENDED) of the queried task. Event and Synchronization Mechanisms Extended tasks can block and synchronize on event masks (ECC1 and ECC2 conformance classes).

function  SetEvent  [SWS_CP_OS_00006]   StatusType SetEvent(TaskType TaskID, EventMaskType Mask); Sets the event bits for the specified extended task. If the task was waiting for any of these events, it transitions from WAITING to READY.
function  WaitEvent  [SWS_CP_OS_00007]   StatusType WaitEvent(EventMaskType Mask); Causes the calling extended task to transition to WAITING until at least one of the specified events in Mask is set.

function  ClearEvent  [SWS_CP_OS_00008]   StatusType ClearEvent(EventMaskType Mask); Clears the specified event bits from the event mask of the calling extended task. Alarms and Resource Management Alarms trigger cyclic activations and notifications. Priority ceiling protocol on resources prevents unbounded priority inversion.

function  SetRelAlarm  [SWS_CP_OS_00009]   StatusType SetRelAlarm(AlarmType AlarmID, TickType increment, TickType cycle); Arms an alarm relative to the current counter value. Can be one-shot (cycle = 0) or cyclic (cycle > 0).
function  GetResource  [SWS_CP_OS_00011]   StatusType GetResource(ResourceType ResID); Locks a shared resource and raises the priority of the calling task to the ceiling priority of the resource.
function  ReleaseResource  [SWS_CP_OS_00012]   StatusType ReleaseResource(ResourceType ResID); Unlocks a shared resource and restores the task priority to its previous level.

function  Rte_Read / Rte_Write  [SWS_CP_RTE_00001]   Std_ReturnType Rte_Read_<p>_<o>(<data_type>* data); Std_ReturnType Rte_Write_<p>_<o>(<data_type> data); Explicit Sender-Receiver communication API for reading and writing data elements via component ports with transmission status feedback.

function  Rte_Call  [SWS_CP_RTE_00002]   Std_ReturnType Rte_Call_<p>_<o>(<in_args>, <out_args>); Synchronous or asynchronous Client-Server invocation across SW-C boundaries or down into BSW service components.

function  Rte_Result  [SWS_CP_RTE_00003]   Std_ReturnType Rte_Result_<p>_<o>(<out_args>); Retrieves the response and output arguments for asynchronous Client-Server calls once execution in the server has completed.

function  Rte_IRead / Rte_IWrite  [SWS_CP_RTE_00004]   <data_type> Rte_IRead_<re>_<p>_<o>(void); void Rte_IWrite_<re>_<p>_<o>(<data_type> data); Implicit Sender-Receiver communication API ensuring run-time data consistency within a Runnable Entity by snapshotting values at runnable entry and writing back at exit.

function  Rte_Enter / Rte_Exit  [SWS_CP_RTE_00007]   void Rte_Enter_<area>(void); void Rte_Exit_<area>(void); Enters and exits an Exclusive Area protecting shared resources from concurrent access by interrupting tasks or runnables.

function  BswM_RequestMode  [SWS_CP_SYS_00001]   void BswM_RequestMode(BswM_UserType requesting_user, BswM_ModeType requested_mode); Service to request a BSW or application mode. Evaluates arbitration rules and triggers corresponding action lists.

function  EcuM_Init  [SWS_CP_SYS_00002]   void EcuM_Init(void); Initializes the ECU State Manager during STARTUP Phase I before the OS is started. Sets up low-level drivers and prepares memory hardware.

function  EcuM_StartupTwo  [SWS_CP_SYS_00003]   void EcuM_StartupTwo(void); Carries out STARTUP Phase II activities after the OS has been started and the first BSW tasks are active. Starts the BswM and initializes higher-layer services.
function  EcuM_GoDown  [SWS_CP_SYS_00004]   Std_ReturnType EcuM_GoDown(uint16 callerHash); Instructs the EcuM to prepare shutdown and invoke shutdown hooks across all BSW modules.

function  EcuM_GoHalt  [SWS_CP_SYS_00005]   Std_ReturnType EcuM_GoHalt(void); Places the microcontroller into low-power sleep mode (HALT) awaiting hardware interrupt wakeup events. BSW Mode Manager (BswM) The BswM controls mode arbitration and executes configured action lists based on logical rule evaluations.

function  EcuM_RequestRUN  [SWS_CP_SYS_00006]   Std_ReturnType EcuM_RequestRUN(EcuM_UserType user); Places a RUN state request on behalf of a SW-C or system component to prevent the ECU from transitioning into sleep or shutdown.

function  EcuM_ReleaseRUN  [SWS_CP_SYS_00007]   Std_ReturnType EcuM_ReleaseRUN(EcuM_UserType user); Releases a previously requested RUN state. When all RUN requests are released, EcuM permits transition to POST_RUN and shutdown.
function  BswM_Init  [SWS_CP_SYS_00010]   void BswM_Init(const BswM_ConfigType* ConfigPtr); Initializes the mode arbitration tables, state rules, and action list dispatchers.

function  BswM_MainFunction  [SWS_CP_SYS_00011]   void BswM_MainFunction(void); Periodic scheduled task for deferred mode rule evaluation and cyclic state processing. Watchdog Manager (WdgM) The WdgM supervises the correct execution of safety-critical software entities via Alive, Deadline, and Logical supervision mechanisms.

function  WdgM_Init  [SWS_CP_SYS_00020]   void WdgM_Init(const WdgM_ConfigType* ConfigPtr); Initializes the Watchdog Manager and configures supervision parameters for all registered supervised entities.

function  WdgM_CheckpointReached  [SWS_CP_SYS_00021]   Std_ReturnType WdgM_CheckpointReached(WdgM_SupervisedEntityIdType SEID, WdgM_CheckpointIdType CPID); Notifies the WdgM that a supervised execution checkpoint has been reached, updating Alive counters, Deadline timers, and Logical execution graph transitions.

function  WdgM_SetMode  [SWS_CP_SYS_00022]   Std_ReturnType WdgM_SetMode(WdgM_ModeType Mode); Switches watchdog supervision modes (e.g. SLOW_SUPERVISION, FAST_SUPERVISION, STOPPED_SUPERVISION) depending on vehicle operating states.

function  WdgM_MainFunction  [SWS_CP_SYS_00023]   void WdgM_MainFunction(void); Cyclically calculates global supervision status and triggers the Watchdog Interface (WdgIf) / Watchdog Driver if conditions are satisfied.
